faqs.question: Is Memorial Day always on the last Monday of May?
faqs.answer: Yes, Memorial Day is observed on the last Monday of May every year. This was established by the Uniform Monday Holiday Act of 1968, which moved the holiday from its original date of May 30 to the last Monday in May.

faqs.question: Will the 2026 World Cup affect Memorial Day travel?

faqs.question: What is the difference between Memorial Day and Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: Memorial Day honors military personnel who died while serving their country. Veterans Day, observed on November 11, celebrates and honors all military veterans who served in the United States Armed Forces, regardless of whether they are living or deceased.

Memorial Day 2026: What You Need to Know

Memorial Day in 2026 falls on Monday, May 25. This federal holiday honors the men and women who died while serving in the United States military.

It is observed annually on the last Monday of May, marking the unofficial start of the summer season for many Americans.

Understanding the 2026 Calendar

Planning ahead requires looking at the broader calendar for 2026. Memorial Day arrives just as the spring season concludes and summer activities begin.

If you are tracking other major events, St. Patrick's Day 2026 falls on Tuesday, March 17.

Ramadan, which shifts annually based on the lunar calendar, is expected to begin around February 17, 2026, and conclude around March 18, 2026.

Pokemon Day 2026 will take place on February 27, as it does every year. Pride Month follows shortly after Memorial Day, officially beginning on June 1, 2026.

How to Observe Memorial Day

The primary purpose of Memorial Day is to honor those who died in military service. Many communities hold parades, cemetery visits, and memorial services.

The National Moment of Remembrance takes place at 3:00 p.m. local time on Memorial Day. Americans are encouraged to pause for one minute of silence to pay their respects.

Flags should be flown at half-staff from sunrise until noon. After noon, the flag is raised to the top of the staff for the remainder of the day.

Travel and Logistics

Memorial Day weekend is one of the busiest travel times of the year. Expect heavy traffic on major highways and high demand for flights.

If you plan to travel, book your accommodations and transportation as early as possible. Prices for flights and hotels often spike as the holiday approaches.

Check local weather forecasts a few days before the holiday. Early summer weather can be unpredictable, affecting outdoor plans like picnics or beach trips.

Yes, Memorial Day is observed on the last Monday of May every year. This was established by the Uniform Monday Holiday Act of 1968, which moved the holiday from its original date of May 30 to the last Monday in May.

Will the 2026 World Cup affect Memorial Day travel?

What is the difference between Memorial Day and Veterans Day?

Are post offices open on Memorial Day 2026?
